evidence: E1: Self-derived 4-axis predictor framework in qa.md Q11/Q12 — optimal_synthetic_ratio = f(verifier, taxonomy, long-tail, substrate). Two axes (verifier, taxonomy) push synthetic UP; two (long-tail, substrate) push real web UP. This framework formulation is the chapter's *implicit* thesis explicitly articulated by learner across qa.md Q9-Q12, becoming the organizing principle of ch-21 summary §8.

E2: Clean Stage 1 self-correction — three initial axis-value errors (verifier definition confused 'importance' with 'mechanical verifiability'; long-tail LOW reversed reality; taxonomy underrated) all corrected after one push by re-applying Q7 framework (grammar enables verifier; verifier reduces noise). Recovery pattern signals framework internalization at *derivation* level not memorization.

E3: Framework extension #1 — Negative anchor *generation-side* (Job C). Ch-20 verdict E6 introduced negative anchor as filter-side (Job B pipeline regression test). Learner extended to *generation-side* use: 'data generation as few-shot prompting (bad example: ...)'. Symmetric expansion of E6 — filter-side (catch bad) + generation-side (prevent bad). Real framework move beyond chapter text.

E4: Framework extension #2 — Axis 5 LOW dual manifestation. After push on Stage 5, learner articulated TWO complementary framings of axis 5 absence: (a) data-side bias ('A and B both valid → A-side-only data → biased model'), (b) verifier-mechanism failure ('LLM-judge biased → inheritance; no GT → weak signal → noise'). Ch-20 axis 5 treatment is technical-only; learner's dual framing covers deployment-consequence + technical-mechanism.

E5: Pipeline composition (Stage 3) — dual-track design echoing Cosmopedia 145-cluster audit move: GLAN-style top-down taxonomy extraction (model-driven) PLUS bottom-up seed-driven taxonomy extraction (1K human curated), then dedup-merge. Synthesizes ch-21 papers' two strategies into one pipeline.

E6: Q9 (all-textbook fail) self-derived — learner independently produced the systematic-bias-vs-random-noise distinction without prompt, identifying contamination + curator blind spot + distribution mismatch as 3 of 5 fail modes. Same internalization pattern as ch-19 verdict E1 explicit-composition strength.

E7: Q10 bootstrapping paradox articulated — 'ALL synthetic requires generator that already knows ALL, recursive impossibility'. Connects to ch-23 model collapse forward-link and identifies real data as 'grounding anchor, not replaceable substrate'. Information-theoretic framing higher than chapter text level.

E8: Cross-chapter framework synthesis — ch-20 axis 5 quirks inheritance correctly invoked in Stage 5 verifier-mechanism failure; ch-19 E5 diversity ceiling explicitly named as 'directly answered by top-down taxonomy' in summary §10 connections; ch-18 generate→filter→dedup→verify loop invoked in Stage 3 pipeline (with confusion between ch-18 4-stage loop and ch-21 3-layer architecture noted as gap).
rationale: Two above-bar framework extensions in addition to the qa.md framework formulation itself (4-axis predictor) and the clean Stage 1 self-correction. The negative-anchor-generation-side extension is structurally identical to ch-19 verdict E6 (pass@k reinvention) and ch-20 verdict E6 (negative anchor) — same signature of applying framework to novel domain + producing new use cases beyond chapter text. The axis 5 LOW dual manifestation extension covers what ch-20's axis 5 treatment leaves implicit (technical mechanism only, no deployment consequence framing). Real gaps exist: Stage 1 initial 3 axis errors (verifier definition, long-tail in legal, taxonomy completeness) were significant — confusion between *importance of accuracy* and *mechanical verifiability* suggested partial blur of Q7 framework, but recovery on one push demonstrates re-derivation capability rather than rote loss; Stage 4 anchor mechanism articulation underspecified; Stage 5 initial 2 items missed minimum count plus critical axis 5 catastrophic failure required push to surface; summary §5 conflates ch-18 4-stage loop with ch-21 3-layer architecture (not corrected); summary §10 thin without backfill (teacher-filled for unread chapters). Net: framework internalization at synthesis level is mastery-quality; the 4-axis predictor framework formulation in qa.md is a self-derived organizing principle worth recording for forward chapters; initial axis errors were corrected cleanly enough to evidence derivation-level understanding. The two framework extensions plus 4-axis formulation exceed the bar.
